## Problem and change

What does a reader or contributor experience before and after this change?

## Verification

Commands run and results; screenshots for UI changes in light/dark. Explain checks
not run and why. No paid AI or publisher account should be needed for core tests.

## Sources and compatibility

If relevant: exact edition, rights, primary evidence, contrary readings, changed
snapshots, migration behavior, privacy and accessibility. Otherwise write N/A.

## Contribution disclosure

Describe substantial AI assistance and how you verified it, if applicable. Confirm
that no private notes, credentials or uncleared copyrighted text are included.
